title: Cold rebuild: which family is it?
summary: Write the os-release family detector again, on a real fleet, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *What am I running?* you wrote `osfamily`, which reads `ID` and `ID_LIKE` from
`os-release` and names the distro family. Now write it again from memory: the same fleet, **no hints, no solution to
peek at**. The checks are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old script feels like knowing it;
writing it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson, then come back
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Which family is it? Cold
prompt: from `ID` first and then each word of `ID_LIKE`: debian/ubuntu, rhel/fedora/centos/rocky/almalinux/amzn,
suse/sles/opensuse*, arch, alpine. Test it on `~/fleet/*/os-release`.
From memory: no hints this time.
